high_level_description: The image is a news article headline from the "SPACE SCIENCE" section, featuring an article titled "Rare Beauty Unveiled: NASA Shares a Breathtaking Display of Gigantic Jets Soaring Over the Himalayas!" The article is by Anuja Vartak and was published 24 hours ago via TWC India. The main focus of the image is a photograph of a stunning natural phenomenon captured over the Himalayan Mountains. The photograph shows four towering, colorful jets of light, resembling fireworks or lightning, rising into the night sky.
